clue.text: Women drunk beer: he worked on bars

explanation.definitionFit: Weber composed operas such as Der Freischütz, so he wrote music measured in bars.

clue.text: Playing advantage to break John McEnroe – glad, ultimately at a loss for American

the last letters of John, McEnroe and glad
